method: Internal AI bilingual reading (Claude, also the developer) of every post-freeze target across six dimensions, same severity scale as CP21. Not human or independent review. Severity assigned before comparing with the CP21 baseline run.
comparisonWithCP21: Pristine CP21 code produced byte-identical targets for all 16 cases (CP21_BASELINE_SAME_CORPUS.json). CP22 differs only by visible coverage notes (6 cases), including on 2 of 6 critical errors (H01, H02). The CP22 repair mechanism did not trigger on this unseen corpus.

rows.source: Doubling the length of a pendulum does not double its period. The period grows with the square root of the length.
rows.actualTarget: Dua kali lipat panjang pendulum tidak berlipat ganda dari periodenya. Periode tumbuh dengan akar kuadrat panjang.
rows.reason: Doubling/period claim is malformed ("tidak berlipat ganda dari periodenya"); the non-proportionality claim is not preserved.

rows.source: The mutant strain grew more slowly at 37 °C, but its final cell density was similar to that of the wild type. Growth rate and yield must therefore be reported separately.
rows.actualTarget: Strain mutan tumbuh lebih lambat pada 37 °C, namun kepadatan sel terakhirnya mirip dengan jenis liar. Tingkat pertumbuhan dan hasil harus dilaporkan secara terpisah.
rows.reason: "therefore" (inference from the observation to separate reporting) omitted; wild type rendered "jenis liar".

rows.source: A correlation coefficient of 0.8 indicates a strong linear association. It does not show which variable influences the other.
rows.actualTarget: Koefisien korelasi dari 0.8 mengindikasikan asosiasi linear yang kuat. Ini tidak menunjukkan variabel mana yang mempengaruhi yang lain.
rows.reason: Strong linear association and non-directionality preserved; "dari 0.8" slightly awkward.

rows.source: The catalyst shortened the time needed to reach equilibrium. It did not change the final ratio of products to reactants.
rows.actualTarget: Katalis dipersingkat waktu yang diperlukan untuk mencapai kesetimbangan. Hal itu tidak mengubah rasio akhir produk menjadi reaktan.
rows.reason: "Katalis dipersingkat" inverts agent/voice; "rasio akhir produk menjadi reaktan" turns "ratio of products to reactants" into products becoming reactants.

rows.source: Inflation reduces the real value of fixed loan repayments. Borrowers therefore benefit when inflation exceeds the rate they expected.
rows.actualTarget: Inflasi mengurangi nilai sebenarnya dari pembayaran pinjaman yang tetap. Oleh karena itu, para peminjam memperoleh manfaat sewaktu inflasi melebihi tingkat yang mereka harapkan.
rows.reason: "real value" rendered "nilai sebenarnya" (actual value) instead of nilai riil; economic term changed. Flagged by coverage note.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "real" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.
Periksa konsep: "rate" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.

rows.source: Every finite set of real numbers has a largest element. An infinite set may have no largest element even if all of its elements are smaller than 1.
rows.actualTarget: Setiap himpunan hingga dari bilangan real memiliki elemen terbesar. Sebuah himpunan tak hingga mungkin tidak memiliki elemen terbesar bahkan jika semua elemennya lebih kecil dari 1.
rows.reason: Finite/infinite, largest element, bound 1 and modality preserved.

rows.source: The vaccine reduced hospital admissions by 40 percent among older adults. Its effect on mild infections was not measured in this trial.
rows.actualTarget: Vaksin ini diturunkan rawat inap oleh 40 persen di antara orang dewasa yang lebih tua. Efeknya pada infeksi ringan tidak diukur dalam uji coba ini.
rows.reason: "Vaksin ini diturunkan rawat inap oleh 40 persen": active reduction becomes passive with "oleh" (agent); the 40 percent reduction claim becomes ungrammatical/ambiguous.

rows.source: Sediment cores record changes in rainfall over several centuries. Gaps in deposition can make two distant layers appear consecutive.
rows.actualTarget: Inti Sedimen merekam perubahan curah hujan selama beberapa abad. Celah dalam deposisi dapat membuat dua lapisan jauh muncul berturut-turut.
rows.reason: Meaning preserved; "Inti Sedimen" capitalisation and "muncul berturut-turut" wording.

rows.source: Gaya gesek bekerja berlawanan dengan arah gerak benda. Besarnya bergantung pada jenis permukaan, bukan pada luas bidang sentuh.
rows.actualTarget: The stroke style works in opposite direction to the object. The size depends on the surface type, not the area of touch.
rows.reason: "Gaya gesek" (friction force) became "stroke style"; motion referent lost. Detected: visible coverage note in output.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "gesek", "gerak" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.
Periksa konsep: "luas", "bidang" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.

rows.source: Median lebih tahan terhadap nilai ekstrem daripada rata-rata. Karena itu, median sering dipilih untuk data pendapatan yang menceng.
rows.actualTarget: Median is more resistant to extreme value than average. Hence, medians are often selected for supporting income data.
rows.reason: "menceng" (skewed) became "supporting"; the reason for preferring the median is lost. Detected: visible coverage note.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "menceng" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.

rows.source: Larutan penyangga mempertahankan pH ketika sedikit asam ditambahkan. Kapasitasnya terbatas dan dapat habis jika asam terus ditambahkan.
rows.actualTarget: Solution buffer maintains pH when a little acid is added. The capacity is limited and can be exhausted if the acid continues to be added.
rows.reason: "Solution buffer" order reversed (buffer solution); capacity limit and exhaustion preserved.

rows.source: Tanaman yang kekurangan nitrogen menunjukkan daun yang menguning. Gejala ini juga dapat muncul akibat kekurangan air, sehingga diagnosis memerlukan uji tanah.
rows.actualTarget: The nitrogen-deprived plant shows yellowing leaves. These symptoms can also be attributed to water shortages, so diagnosis requires soil testing.
rows.reason: Nitrogen deficiency, yellowing, alternative cause and need for soil test preserved.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "muncul" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.

rows.source: Subsidi harga pupuk menurunkan biaya produksi petani. Namun, manfaatnya berkurang jika pupuk tidak tersedia tepat waktu.
rows.actualTarget: Subsidi harga pupuk menurunkan biaya produksi petani. Namun, manfaatnya berkurang jika pupuk tidak tersedia tepat waktu.
rows.reason: Safe rejection (direction-of-change guard); source preserved with marker. Not a translation.
visibleIssues: Kandidat terjemahan ditolak untuk menjaga isi. Sumber dipertahankan. Periksa teks sumber atau ubah glosarium, lalu jalankan kembali; percobaan identik tidak diulang.

rows.source: Peneliti mewawancarai 25 guru dari tiga sekolah negeri. Temuan ini tidak dapat digeneralisasi ke sekolah swasta tanpa data tambahan.
rows.actualTarget: Researchers interview 25 teachers from three public schools. This discovery cannot be generalized into private schools without additional data.
rows.reason: "This discovery" for temuan, tense "interview"; generalisation limit preserved.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "negeri" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.

rows.source: Turunan fungsi konstan selalu nol. Sebaliknya, fungsi dengan turunan nol pada suatu interval adalah konstan pada interval tersebut.
rows.actualTarget: Derivative constant functions are always zero. Instead, the function with derivative zero at an interval is constant at that interval.
rows.reason: "Derivative constant functions are always zero" garbles the subject; "Sebaliknya" (conversely) rendered "Instead", obscuring that the second sentence is the converse.

rows.source: Pasien yang menghentikan pengobatan lebih awal dikeluarkan dari analisis utama. Pengecualian ini dapat membuat efek pengobatan tampak lebih besar.
rows.actualTarget: Patients who stopped treatment earlier were removed from primary analysis. These exceptions can make the treatment effect appear larger.
rows.reason: "Pengecualian" (exclusion from analysis) rendered "exceptions"; methodological term changed.
visibleIssues: Periksa konsep: "awal", "dikeluarkan" mungkin hilang atau berubah dalam terjemahan.
